user.title: Prayer times (Morocco)
user.description:
This integration provides the times of the five prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) and sunrise for your home, extra zones, and the Home Assistant people wherever they currently are. It creates timestamp sensors and a "Next prayer" sensor, to trigger notifications or the adhan on your speakers.

"Data repository" source: JSON files from a GitHub repository (editable address). "Local calculation" source: computed by Home Assistant with the Morocco method (Fajr 19°, Isha 17°), no connection needed; it can differ from the official tables by a few minutes.
